circuit_encoding.validity: For exactly-K subsets with K>=7, banning every inclusion-minimal dependent subset of sizes 4..7 is equivalent, on the original point variables, to banning every dependent 7-subset.
circuit_encoding.scope_limit: This is only a fixed-cardinality existence equivalence. It does not encode legal positions of size below 7, legal moves, or Grundy values.

lessons: Circuit-only clauses do not describe arbitrary game positions: a dependent set of fewer than 7 points is still a legal position.
Under an exactly-K constraint with K>=7, all dependent 7-subsets are forbidden iff all circuits of sizes 4..7 are forbidden.
The fixed-cardinality equivalence does not certify that the d=6 circuit enumerator is complete and does not provide an UNSAT result.
verification_plan: Independently audit the d=6 circuit enumeration against the complete dependent-7-set list or a second circuit enumerator.
Verify the exactly-10 cardinality encoding and generate an UNSAT proof for the complete or circuit-reduced CNF.
Alternatively, find and geometrically verify a 10-point general-position set.
